text:
alexa_marketing: Putting together a compact solution brief + one-pager for post-webinar distribution. Focus: secure deployment modes, concise SLA language, and routing rules for regulated leads. Need ad variants and AE handoff checklist.

ranjit_growth: For paid/social we'll A/B test two CTAs first 14 days: 'Book a compliance review' vs 'Get SLA options'. Track lead quality and demo conversion.

tess_sales: Handoff must include: one-pager PDF, 3-line AE opener, 3 common objections + counters, pricing band. Important: any lead with tags (gov|health|banking|audit) -> enterprise-sdr queue.

omar_prod: Benchmarks to add (anonymized): 'Customer pilot: 5k context, reserved private pool p99 ~112ms; prefix caching lowered token spend ~33%.' Also note hosted shared pools have variable p99 (~160-280ms).

claire_content: I'll draft three micro-voices: 1) Compliance-first (trusty tone), 2) Performance-first (latency metrics), 3) Predictable-cost (pricing assurance). Each will be ~80-100 char headline + one-line subhead.

neil_ops: Routing rules proposal: keyword match OR checkbox on form -> enterprise-sdr. Scoring override: estimated_arr > 125000 => assign AE. Webhook example: POST https://hooks.redwood/internal-leads with auth header.

alexa_marketing: Include an "elevator benchmark" box template so AEs can swap numbers: "ANON CUSTOMER: 5k context — p99: 112ms (reserved) — token savings: 33% w/ prefix caching". Keep phrasing anonymized.

tess_sales: Also include short JSON snippet for routing logic so AEs/devs can inspect: 'rule: match(tags, /gov|health|finserv|audit/i) -> queue enterprise-sdr; priority: estimated_arr>125000 -> assign AE'.

legal_bot: Use 'contractual SLA' only for Dedicated/Private paid contracts. For hosted, use 'target latency' and 'published targets' language rather than promises. Remove absolute latency claims for hosted in public collateral.

omear_ops: (typo fix) neil_ops meant. I'll add webhook payload example below and set required auth.

omear_ops: Webhook payload example:
POST https://hooks.redwood/internal-leads
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <internal-token>
{
  "company": "<company>",
  "contact_email": "<email>",
  "tags": ["<tags>"],
  "estimated_arr": "<num>",
  "source": "webinar|paid_ad|social"
}

claire_content: Draft micro-copy (headline - subhead):
1) Compliance-first - "Private Pods with auditable controls." - "HSM-backed key control, audit logs, and contractual SLAs for regulated teams."
2) Performance-first - "Consistent low-latency for long context." - "Dedicated pools tuned for sub-150ms p99 on realistic workloads."
3) Predictable-cost - "Reserved capacity, predictable unit economics." - "Caching and batching playbooks to reduce per-token spend and stabilize pricing."

ranjit_growth: UTMs I'll use: utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=secure_launch, utm_content={cta_variant}. Also will include click-to-demo vs click-to-pricing funnels.

alexa_marketing: AE cheat-sheet items: opener line, 3 rebuttals, where to find benchmark box in the drive, and the webhook mapping. Keep cheat-sheet to one slide ~90 seconds of talking points.

neil_ops: Timeline: one-pager draft today, legal review tomorrow AM, webhook/routing test by EOD, A/B launch on Thursday.

alexa_marketing: Sounds good. Claire, can you upload three micro-copy variants + a ready-to-export PDF mock by 5pm? Tag Tess when ready. Anything else?
